cd /app/tmp/fresh && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *
# Build a heavy but legal input (~31MB) and run under evaluator-like limits
big_body = b"x" * 1500
req = mkreq(headers=std_headers(body=big_body) + [("P-Preferred-Identity",'"N,ame" <sip:desk@lab.test>,'),("\t<tel:+12025550100>"),("Privacy","id"),("X-Junk","y"*150)], body=big_body)
evs = [ev(i, "edge", "alice", "external", req.hex()) for i in range(6200)]
raw = json.dumps(envelope(evs, base_config(cap=10000))).encode()
print("input MB:", round(len(raw)/1e6, 2))
open('heavy.json','wb').write(raw)
t0 = time.time()
# 512 MiB address space, 30s CPU, 45s wall, 64 fds
p = subprocess.run(['bash','-c',
  'ulimit -v 524288; ulimit -t 30; ulimit -f 20000; exec python3 -I -B /app/submission/main.py < heavy.json > heavy.out 2>heavy.err'],
  capture_output=True, timeout=60)
print("rc:", p.returncode, "wall:", round(time.time()-t0,2))
print("stderr:", open('heavy.err').read()[:300])
d = json.load(open('heavy.out'))
print("results:", len(d["results"]), "accepted:", d["accepted"], "replayed:", d["replayed"], "live:", d["live"])
print("out MB:", round(os.path.getsize('heavy.out')/1e6,2))
EOF
